dialogues.speaker: "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness"
dialogues.text: I was delighted to hear that you were holding another festival, Itto. As such, I have commissioned a set of audio equipment as a congratulatory gift.

dialogues.speaker: "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness"
dialogues.text: Also, I have recently heard the children of Hanamizaka saying, "Ayato of the South, Itto of the North." Could you enlighten me as to what that means?
